newsitem.title: ITALY: Telecom Italia H1 pre-tax profit jumps.
newsitem.headline: Telecom Italia H1 pre-tax profit jumps.

text.p: Note: Telecom Italia said in a statement it expected its full year results would be "significantly" better than 1995 results despite the fact its mobile telephone operations were hived off in July 1995 into Telecom Italia Mobile.
Note: Telecom Italia said its board had approved a three year plan for 1997-99 which envisaged investments during that period of more than 25 trillion lire.
It said investments in the first half of 1996, all self-financed, rose 17 percent over the same period last year to 3.47 trillion lire.
It said the number of fixed-line clients rose to 25.03 million at end June from 24.85 million at end December 1995.
Telecom said 97 percent of Italian families now owned telephones.
It said the firm employed 89,300 people at the end of June against 90,222 at the end of last year.
First half 1995 data does not include the results from Telecom's mobile phone division which was de-merged in July. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
